sections.Profile:
Derby Day , produced by Williams Electronic Games Inc. in October 1967, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Steve Kordek with artwork by Christian Marche. This two-player game features a horse-racing theme where players aim to advance their chosen horses across the backglass using the game’s mechanical animations.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1967
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Racing, Horses, Original Theme, Horse Racing
